Limited explicit structural revision of the remaining data-adaptation composition only. Preserve accepted requirements and exact output contracts, existing acquisition/search/submission/individual product visits/writer/cleanup operations and ordering, fixed output path, maximum ten products, all permissions/limits, and the removal of unrequested work. Compilation is clean but review rejects the following concrete adaptation defects.
1. Do not invent id or sourcePageIndex/sourceRecordIndex in learned extraction. The observed record.reference is the producer identity for offered actionable/link candidates; copy that exact observed reference as candidateKey, with only observedText needed for selection. Treat missing required identity as unavailable, not an invented index. Remove the unused source index fields. each input pages and assembled rows array<array<Candidate>> remain valid.
2. Replace projectHomeOriginalRecordsByPage and projectSearchOriginalRecordsByPage learned copying with minimal typed page foreach projections: items=field(output(acquisition, observationSnapshot),pages); empty body.tasks; body.outputs records=field(item,records). Then flatten the collected records arrays where consumed. These are the actual original records, with reference/href/actions/etc unchanged; do not reconstruct them through inference. Group related exports if needed.
3. Validate selected IDs against the offered compact candidate array using lookup(port=candidateKey, items=[flatten(extract.rows), selectedIds]); a minimal pure foreach over that lookup can export validated IDs from field(item,candidateKey). Lookup originals using port=reference, records=flatten(originalProjection.records), ids=validatedIDs. This is the existing typed reconnection path; no field access on an array. Repeated IDs retain order.
4. Remove resolveSearchReference interpretation. Use the one-element selected original control collection in a bounded effectful foreach(maxItems=1), fillSearchQuery using field(item,reference) and the approved query input, submit=true. Keep a local non-null reference requires; Browser validates fill compatibility. Export the real fill result through the loop and preserve dependent readSearchResults ordering. Never have interpretation regenerate a reference.
5. Remove buildProductsToVisit interpretation. visitEachProduct iterates the original-record lookup directly and readProductPage.url=field(item,href), with a non-null href requires. No model reconstructs URL, reference or action arguments after selection. Candidate selection remains a genuine interpretation of compact labels returning at most ten observed IDs in the original order, without extra criteria, filtering or deduplication. Assert a non-null selection error fails rather than turning it into an empty successful selection.
6. Replace whole productObservation in extractProductRow with per-page extract.each over readProductPage.observationSnapshot.pages. Emit only compact observed name/description/price facts per page, then reconcile the complete compact facts if a global decision is needed. No raw snapshot alongside compact facts. Each extraction checks actual acquisition success, snapshot non-null, captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false using explicit local requires. Preserve all pages and allowed missing fields. The final row is non-null with accepted nullable name/description/price/url/error fields; copy actual URL deterministically into the exported row. Do not infer completeness or success from objective text.
7. Keep the existing single bounded TSV formatting stage and actual writer. Outputs remain direct typed product rows, writer.filePath and writer.success, with cleanup unchanged. Preserve necessary validation boundaries; omit value-forwarding tasks when existing consumer bindings suffice.
Use only discovered contracts and existing each/foreach/flatten/lookup/object/output/field bindings. This authorizes only these adaptation repairs, not new business work or altered intent.
